name: Gasthof Sonnenhof
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Sonnenhof in Krün**

Welcome to the **Inn Sonnenhof** in the picturesque village of **Krün**, nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this cozy retreat offers breathtaking mountain views and authentic Tyrolean hospitality.

Indulge in traditional dishes like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, or freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**, all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning **Karwendel** region, unwind in our rustic yet modern rooms—each designed to make you feel right at home.

Whether you're seeking relaxation or adventure, the **Inn Sonnenhof** promises an unforgettable stay in the serene beauty of **Krün**.
